changes.name: MeteorUpgradeSystemV12
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local world=workspace:WaitForChild("MeteorGame")

local old=world:FindFirstChild("UpgradeStations")
if old then old:Destroy() end

local defs={
 {key="MiningPower",title="MINING POWER",effect="+1 damage per level",base=20,pos=Vector3.new(-55,4,-14),color=Color3.fromRGB(255,120,70)},
 {key="MiningSpeed",title="MINING SPEED",effect="Faster swings each level",base=30,pos=Vector3.new(-55,4,0),color=Color3.fromRGB(80,180,255)},
 {key="MiningLuck",title="LUCK",effect="More bonus Gem chances",base=40,pos=Vector3.new(-55,4,14),color=Color3.fromRGB(190,100,255)}
}

local folder=Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Name="UpgradeStations"
folder.Parent=world

local function setupPlayer(p)
 for _,d in ipairs(defs) do
  if not p:FindFirstChild(d.key) then
   local v=Instance.new("IntValue")
   v.Name=d.key
   v.Value=0
   v.Parent=p
  end
 end
end

for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do setupPlayer(p) end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setupPlayer)

local stations={}

local function getDisplayLevel(key)
 local p=Players:GetPlayers()[1]
 if not p then return 0 end
 local v=p:FindFirstChild(key)
 return v and v.Value or 0
end

local function refreshStation(d)
 local info=stations[d.key]
 if not info then return end
 local level=getDisplayLevel(d.key)
 local cost=d.base*(level+1)
 info.text.Text=d.title.."\nLEVEL "..level.."\n"..d.effect.."\nNEXT: 💎 "..cost
 info.prompt.ActionText="BUY - "..cost.." GEMS"
 info.prompt.ObjectText=d.title.."  |  LEVEL "..level
end

for _,d in ipairs(defs) do
 local b=Instance.new("Part")
 b.Name=d.key.."Station"
 b.Size=Vector3.new(15,7,2)
 b.Position=d.pos
 b.Orientation=Vector3.new(0,-90,0)
 b.Anchored=true
 b.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
 b.Color=Color3.fromRGB(30,34,42)
 b.Parent=folder

 local light=Instance.new("PointLight")
 light.Color=d.color
 light.Brightness=1.4
 light.Range=14
 light.Parent=b

 local gui=Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
 gui.Face=Enum.NormalId.Front
 gui.CanvasSize=Vector2.new(700,340)
 gui.Parent=b

 local txt=Instance.new("TextLabel")
 txt.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
 txt.BackgroundTransparency=1
 txt.TextColor3=d.color
 txt.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
 txt.TextScaled=true
 txt.TextWrapped=true
 txt.Parent=gui

 local pad=Instance.new("UIPadding")
 pad.PaddingTop=UDim.new(0,20)
 pad.PaddingBottom=UDim.new(0,20)
 pad.PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,25)
 pad.PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,25)
 pad.Parent=txt

 local prompt=Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
 prompt.HoldDuration=.15
 prompt.MaxActivationDistance=10
 prompt.RequiresLineOfSight=false
 prompt.Parent=b

 stations[d.key]={text=txt,prompt=prompt}

 prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(p)
  local lv=p:FindFirstChild(d.key)
  local gems=p:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and p.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Gems")
  if not lv or not gems then return end
  local cost=d.base*(lv.Value+1)
  if gems.Value>=cost then
   gems.Value-=cost
   lv.Value+=1
   refreshStation(d)
  end
 end)

 refreshStation(d)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p)
 task.wait(.25)
 for _,d in ipairs(defs) do
  local v=p:FindFirstChild(d.key)
  if v then
   v:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
    refreshStation(d)
   end)
  end
 end
end)

for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
 for _,d in ipairs(defs) do
  local v=p:FindFirstChild(d.key)
  if v then
   v:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
    refreshStation(d)
   end)
  end
 end
end

print("Meteor upgrade displays loaded")
